description: This file defines the VarDefHandler class, which manages variable definitions and metadata for modules within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for retrieving variable definitions, filtering by type, and handling associated options and relationships.

classes.name: VarDefHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing variable definitions, options, and metadata for CRM modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VarDefHandler with a module and optional metadata array name, loading relevant metadata if provided.

methods.name: get_vardef_array
methods.description: Retrieves an array of variable definitions, optionally filtering, removing duplicates, and localizing labels.

methods.name: compare_type
methods.description: Compares a given variable definition against the target metadata filters to determine suitability.
